verses.literal: Gather yourselves gather together O shameful . . . nation

verses.original: בְּטֶ֙רֶם֙ חֹ֔ק לֶ֣דֶת י֑וֹם עָ֣בַר כְּמֹ֖ץ בְּטֶ֣רֶם׀ לֹא־ חֲרוֹן֙ אַף־ יְהוָ֔ה יָב֣וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם בְּטֶ֙רֶם֙ לֹא־ י֖וֹם יְהוָֽה׃ אַף־ יָב֣וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem ḥōq le·ḏeṯ yō·wm ‘ā·ḇar kə·mōṣ bə·ṭe·rem lō- ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh yā·ḇō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·ṭe·rem lō- yō·wm Yah·weh ’ap̄- yā·ḇō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: before the decree takes effect and the day passes like chaff before . . . the burning anger of the LORD comes upon you before . . . the Day of the LORD’s anger comes upon you

verses.original: בַּקְּשׁ֤וּ אֶת־ יְהוָה֙ כָּל־ עַנְוֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּעָ֑לוּ מִשְׁפָּט֖וֹ בַּקְּשׁוּ־ צֶ֙דֶק֙ בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ עֲנָוָ֔ה אוּלַי֙ תִּסָּ֣תְר֔וּ בְּי֖וֹם יְהוָֽה׃ אַף־
verses.transliteration: baq·qə·šū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kāl- ‘an·wê hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer pā·‘ā·lū miš·pā·ṭōw baq·qə·šū- ṣe·ḏeq baq·qə·šū ‘ă·nā·wāh ’ū·lay tis·sā·ṯə·rū bə·yō·wm Yah·weh ’ap̄-
verses.literal: Seek - the LORD all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice Seek righteousness seek humility Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD’s anger

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַזָּה֙ תִֽהְיֶ֔ה עֲזוּבָ֣ה וְאַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לִשְׁמָמָ֑ה אַשְׁדּ֗וֹד יְגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּהָ בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֙יִם֙ וְעֶקְר֖וֹן תֵּעָקֵֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ‘az·zāh ṯih·yeh ‘ă·zū·ḇāh wə·’aš·qə·lō·wn liš·mā·māh ’aš·dō·wḏ yə·ḡā·rə·šū·hā baṣ·ṣā·ho·ra·yim wə·‘eq·rō·wn tê·‘ā·qêr
verses.literal: For Gaza will be abandoned and Ashkelon left in ruins Ashdod will be driven out at noon and Ekron will be uprooted

verses.original: ה֗וֹי יֹֽשְׁבֵ֛י חֶ֥בֶל הַיָּ֖ם גּ֣וֹי כְּרֵתִ֑ים דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם כְּנַ֙עַן֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךְ מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w yō·šə·ḇê ḥe·ḇel hay·yām gō·w kə·rê·ṯîm də·ḇar- Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem kə·na·‘an ’e·reṣ pə·liš·tîm wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tîḵ mê·’ên yō·wō·šêḇ
verses.literal: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast O nation of the Cherethites The word of the LORD is against you O Canaan land of the Philistines I will destroy you and no one will be left

verses.original: חֶ֣בֶל הַיָּ֗ם וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה נְוֺ֛ת כְּרֹ֥ת רֹעִ֖ים וְגִדְר֥וֹת צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·ḇel hay·yām wə·hā·yə·ṯāh nə·wōṯ kə·rōṯ rō·‘îm wə·ḡiḏ·rō·wṯ ṣōn
verses.literal: So the seacoast . . . will become [a land of] pastures with wells for shepherds and folds for sheep

verses.original: חֶ֗בֶל וְהָ֣יָה לִשְׁאֵרִ֛ית בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִרְע֑וּן יִרְבָּצ֔וּן בָּעֶ֙רֶב֙ בְּבָתֵּ֣י אַשְׁקְל֗וֹן כִּ֧י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם יִפְקְדֵ֛ם וְשָׁ֥ב שְׁבוּתָם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·ḇel wə·hā·yāh liš·’ê·rîṯ bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘ă·lê·hem yir·‘ūn yir·bā·ṣūn bā·‘e·reḇ bə·ḇāt·tê ’aš·qə·lō·wn kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem yip̄·qə·ḏêm wə·šāḇ šə·ḇū·ṯå̄m
verses.literal: The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah there they will find pasture They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon for the LORD their God will attend to them and restore their captives

verses.original: שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ חֶרְפַּ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְגִדּוּפֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵֽרְפוּ֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וַיַּגְדִּ֖ילוּ עַל־ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî ḥer·paṯ mō·w·’āḇ wə·ḡid·dū·p̄ê bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ’ă·šer ḥê·rə·p̄ū ’eṯ- ‘am·mî way·yaḡ·dî·lū ‘al- gə·ḇū·lām
verses.literal: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites . . . who have taunted - My people and threatened . . . their borders

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֡נִי חַי־ נְאֻם֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּֽי־ מוֹאָ֞ב תִּֽהְיֶה֙ כִּסְדֹ֤ם וּבְנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ כַּֽעֲמֹרָ֔ה מִמְשַׁ֥ק חָר֛וּל וּמִכְרֵה־ מֶ֥לַח עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וּשְׁמָמָ֖ה שְׁאֵרִ֤ית עַמִּי֙ יְבָזּ֔וּם וְיֶ֥תֶר גּוֹי יִנְחָלֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ā·nî ḥay- nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl kî- mō·w·’āḇ tih·yeh kis·ḏōm ū·ḇə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ka·‘ă·mō·rāh mim·šaq ḥā·rūl ū·miḵ·rêh- me·laḥ ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām ū·šə·mā·māh šə·’ê·rîṯ ‘am·mî yə·ḇāz·zūm wə·ye·ṯer goy yin·ḥā·lūm
verses.literal: Therefore as surely as I live declares the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites . . . like Gomorrah a place of weeds and salt pits vvv a perpetual wasteland The remnant of My people will plunder them the remainder of My nation will dispossess them

verses.original: זֹ֥את לָהֶ֖ם תַּ֣חַת גְּאוֹנָ֑ם כִּ֤י חֵֽרְפוּ֙ וַיַּגְדִּ֔לוּ עַל־ עַ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ lā·hem ta·ḥaṯ gə·’ō·w·nām kî ḥê·rə·p̄ū way·yaḡ·di·lū ‘al- ‘am Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: This they shall have in return for their pride for taunting and mocking . . . the people of the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ נוֹרָ֤א עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י רָזָ֔ה אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃ כֹּ֖ל אִיֵּ֥י וְיִשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־ לוֹ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִמְּקוֹמ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh nō·w·rā ‘ă·lê·hem kî rā·zāh ’êṯ kāl- ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·’ā·reṣ hag·gō·w·yim kōl ’î·yê wə·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw ’îš mim·mə·qō·w·mōw
verses.literal: The LORD will be terrifying to them when He starves - all the gods of the earth Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him each in its own place

verses.original: אַתֶּ֣ם כּוּשִׁ֔ים גַּם־ חַֽלְלֵ֥י חַרְבִּ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.literal: You too O Cushites will be slain by My sword . . .

verses.original: וְיֵ֤ט יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ צָפ֔וֹן וִֽיאַבֵּ֖ד אֶת־ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְיָשֵׂ֤ם אֶת־ נִֽינְוֵה֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֔ה צִיָּ֖ה כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yêṭ yā·ḏōw ‘al- ṣā·p̄ō·wn wî·’ab·bêḏ ’eṯ- ’aš·šūr wə·yā·śêm ’eṯ- nî·nə·wêh liš·mā·māh ṣî·yāh kam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy - Assyria He will make - Nineveh a desolation as dry as a desert

verses.original: עֲדָרִים֙ וְרָבְצ֨וּ בְתוֹכָ֤הּ חַיְתוֹ־ ג֔וֹי כָּל־ גַּם־ קָאַת֙ גַּם־ קִפֹּ֔ד יָלִ֑ינוּ בְּכַפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ ק֠וֹל יְשׁוֹרֵ֤ר בַּֽחַלּוֹן֙ חֹ֣רֶב בַּסַּ֔ף כִּ֥י עֵרָֽה׃ אַרְזָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ḏā·rîm wə·rā·ḇə·ṣū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh ḥay·ṯōw- ḡō·w kāl- gam- qā·’aṯ gam- qip·pōḏ yā·lî·nū bə·ḵap̄·tō·re·hā qō·wl yə·šō·w·rêr ba·ḥal·lō·wn ḥō·reḇ bas·sap̄ kî ‘ê·rāh ’ar·zāh
verses.literal: Herds will lie down in her midst creatures . . . of every kind Both the desert owl and screech owl will roost atop her [pillars] Their calls will sound from the window but desolation will lie on the threshold for He will expose the beams of cedar

verses.original: זֹ֠את הָעַלִּיזָה֙ הָעִ֤יר הַיּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָבֶ֔טַח הָאֹֽמְרָה֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔הּ אֲנִ֖י וְאַפְסִ֣י ע֑וֹד אֵ֣יךְ׀ לְשַׁמָּ֗ה הָיְתָ֣ה מַרְבֵּץ֙ לַֽחַיָּ֔ה כֹּ֚ל עוֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ יִשְׁרֹ֖ק יָנִ֥יעַ יָדֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hā·‘al·lî·zāh hā·‘îr hay·yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ hā·’ō·mə·rāh bil·ḇā·ḇāh ’ă·nî wə·’ap̄·sî ‘ō·wḏ ’êḵ lə·šam·māh hā·yə·ṯāh mar·bêṣ la·ḥay·yāh kōl ‘ō·w·ḇêr ‘ā·le·hā yiš·rōq yā·nî·a‘ yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: This carefree city that dwells securely that thinks to herself I [am it] and [there is] none besides me what a ruin she has become a resting place for beasts Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist
